-----insert data in om tasks table
INSERT INTO om.om_tasks SELECT 'TSK_EDS_AREA_DIM','EDS','EDS','AREA_DIM','DEP',NULL,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),NULL;GO

-----insert data in om task dependency table 
INSERT INTO om.om_task_dependency SELECT (SELECT MAX(ISNULL(DEPENDENCY_ID,0)) FROM om.om_task_dependency) + 1,'TSK_EDS_DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE','TSK_EDS_AREA_DIM',NULL; GO
INSERT INTO om.om_task_dependency SELECT (SELECT MAX(ISNULL(DEPENDENCY_ID,0)) FROM om.om_task_dependency) + 1,'TSK_EDS_DEP_SETIDTABLE','TSK_EDS_AREA_DIM',NULL; GO
